name: WORLD_CORE_V10_PACKAGE_CONTINUATION
entry_preconditions: The V09 recovery candidate is bound to the exact base_candidate and has an independent APPROVED_FOR_CONTINUATION review with no open blocker or major.
The project owner confirmed on 2026-09-12 that the required continuation authorizations have passed.
Each implementation point must bind and enforce the ADR decision that is current for its exact scope; no browser or external actor claim is authority.

continuation_rule.condition: The immediately preceding V10 step has an immutable candidate, applicable normal-engineering evidence, and no recorded open P0 or MAJOR blocker.
continuation_rule.effect: Only the immediately following allowed V10 step may start on this scoped branch.
continuation_rule.dependency_exception: An IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED dependency is permitted only between adjacent members of this exact allowed_steps sequence.

preserved_controls: V06 through V10.4 remain IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED until an independent Gate B decision.
P0 invariants, server-side current authorization, exact-or-reject arithmetic, authoritative event lineage, and migration provenance remain mandatory.
V10.4 must retain actual non-production RLS, grant, concurrency, crash-recovery, replay, and rebuild evidence as Gate B inputs.
A BLOCKER or MAJOR stops continuation and requires a recorded forward fix plus a fresh appropriate review.
prohibitions: merge to main before Gate B approval and separate merge authority
production deployment, production migration publication, production access, or shared-Supabase mutation
modification of the original EconMind main website
V11 or any step outside V10.1 through V10.4
